findings.finding: Earlier projection-rate, width and rank candidates were often rejected using the now-obsolete stochastic training proxy. These are not reliable evidence against retesting under full H100 WR conditions.
Five dense-site KS3 substitutions at width2816 all failed later fixed-text screening. Layer8 survived longest, to approximately720s. Avoid combining these unchanged recipes as an initial direction.

All-product prepared FP8 improved MI100 prefix time by2.5% but failed a later compatible probe by+.0354. H100 hardware may change the time benefit; preserve exact precision/error evidence and require full validation.
At one measured checkpoint, removing the cubic spine worsened CE by.03376 while removing the warp changed CE byonly.000107. This motivates cheaper geometry variants but is not retraining evidence.

Pairwise and sparse interactions did not produce a validated winner; backward-kernel numerical changes can perturb later trajectories. Prefer targeted efficiency experiments before increasing geometric complexity.

H100 inspection shows prepared geometry VJP PTX uses exp-based tanh sequences, with no tanh.approx instructions. Native H100 tanh is a candidate pending full-run profile and correctness/microbenchmark gates.
findings.evidence: Inspected compiled _vjp_prepared.ptx in local Triton cache

interpretation: KS3 GEMMs, backward geometry and communication are major costs. Kernel sums overlap and are not additive wall shares. Backward geometry alone sums to 2.50s; native tanh and narrower experts are high-priority tests.
decision: Run native-tanh paired correctness/timing, then one qualifying full trial. Follow with width768 and one dense-layer depth reduction. Preserve the 1.1GB raw trace locally; commit its hash, full kernel summary and CSV.

decision: Run full WR schedule with forward and backward native tanh; unchanged model and optimization hyperparameters.

decision: Debug producer dual layouts while the width trial runs.

decision: Continue width768 full trial independently; do not run full FP8 until every dual layout is bitwise checked.
